newsitem.title: JORDAN: Citibank sponsors first Jordan roadshow in U.S.
newsitem.headline: Citibank sponsors first Jordan roadshow in U.S.

text.p: U.S. Citibank is sponsoring the first investor roadshow next week in the United States to promote Jordan to U.S. investors, the manager of the bank's wholly-owned Jordanian subsidiary said on Wednesday.

Suhair al-Ali, general manager of Citibank's Jordanian operations, said the two day roadshow in three major U.S. cities to be held during June 2-3 will have as guest speakers Jordan's top official economic strategist Jawad Anani, Deputy Prime Minister for development affairs and Rima Khalaf, Planning Minister.
They will brief top U.S. investment banks, portfolio investment and pension fund managers on latest moves to attract foreign investment to Jordan and progress in IMF-directed structural reforms.
"The informational roadshow will promote and familiarise U.S. investors with Jordan and bring the investor persective..it will increase the visibility of Jordan in the U.S.," she said.
U.S. investors were increasingly interested in the Jordanian market which has so far seen minimal capital inflow aside from some U.S. firms interested in the gas and energy sectors, Ali said.
Ali said the focus would be mainly on attracting long-term U.S. investment in Jordanian debt instruments, along with portfolio investment opportunities

Jordan's Citibank, the largest U.S. investor which has steadily expanded its local operations since starting in 1974, was keen to tap growing opportunites in Jordanian debt such as bond offerings by leading firms, Ali said.

Citibank, a subsidiary of Citicorp, has participated actively in syndicated loans offered to leading Jordanian corporate clients to finance a wide range of projects in fertilisers, phosphates and telecommunications.
